High anchor ~1.0 GW of 1.4 GW (~70%; also near a prior ceiling given Anthropic's Nvidia and TPU use); low anchor ~500 MW (~35%). Was (0.4, 0.8) chip-count-anchored before 7/3/26

Anthropic's 2024 full-year cloud compute spend, around The Information's reported $2.5B (90% CI +/-20% for reporting/definition error; widened from +/-12% on 7/30/26 per Josh). Correlated 0.5 with cloud_spend_2025 in code (same reporting). Input to the end-2024 backcast (model_anthropic_2024)

Anthropic's 2025 full-year cloud compute spend, around The Information's reported $6.8B (90% CI ~ +/-20%, geomean ~6.8; widened from +/-12% on 7/30/26 per Josh). Correlated 0.5 with cloud_spend_2024 in code. Input to the end-2024 backcast

Within-2025 spend growth as a multiple of the average 2024->2025 growth (~2.7x/yr): 1 = one smooth exponential through both annual totals; <1 front-loaded; >1 back-loaded. Leans back-loaded and is narrower than pure ignorance (was to(0.6,1.6) before 7/16/26): SemiAnalysis's quarterly Anthropic build hugs the smooth curve through 2024 then runs ~1.3 through 2025, and the WSJ Q1-26 compute+infra figure ($3.4B/qtr ~ $13.6B/yr) lands between the fitted end-2025 rate and SA's steeper Q1-26 build. Sets the end-2024 spending rate in the backcast

Anthropic's effective 2024 price per H100e-hour, billed around the clock. SemiAnalysis's 1-yr H100 contract index runs ~$3/hr through 2023 falling to the low-$2s through 2024; Anthropic's effective rate sits below that curve (multi-year terms, scale and pricing power with closely tied clouds, the TPU v5e slice entering the mix) but can sit above pure GPU-hour pricing since 'compute spend' plausibly includes auxiliary costs (storage, networking, CPU fleets). Divides the end-2024 spending rate in the backcast

Accuracy of the mid-2026 Colossus H100e reads (conversion and satellite power-reading error only, as for 2025). The timing risk on the projected next C2 phase is modeled separately via c2_next_phase_open_h1_2026, so it no longer skews this factor down
